decisions.reason: The accepted stamped concurrence letter remains valid; the source requests a separate stamped schematic presentation of the same material and does not replace or invalidate the letter.
The source expressly characterizes the schematic callouts as the same original-scope electrical material, so the limited review scope and review outcome remain unchanged.
Correspondence between letter headings and schematic descriptions does not change the existing documentation required to verify completed physical modifications.
The source changes the presentation and stamping of electrical callouts but says nothing about the concurrence document's date or date format.
The schematic-callout decision does not alter the Nevada PE's identity, license number, or required signature-block attribution.
The source concerns the Nevada healthcare as-built callouts and does not resolve or modify the separate California credential requirement.
The source addresses original-scope Nevada as-built callouts, not the separate additional-project permit-ready electrical drawing package.
Presenting existing Nevada as-built material on schematic sheets does not change the calculation obligations for the separate additional permit project.
The source contains no decision about HVAC sizing, Title 24, or Manual J, S, and D calculations for the separate permit project.
